profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Google Store
profile.summary:
Eric specializes in designing and developing rich and robust user experiences for the modern web.  His expertise has been used in the creation and maintenance of a wide variety of web-based products including search engines, business intelligence applications, digital testing venues, and personal media tools.

Eric excels at written communication, as evidenced by his early work writing tutorials and technical resources.  He prioritizes written documentation and other resources that are valuable to team members.  The interest in writing extends beyond the technical scope, however, as evidenced by his participation in the National Novel Writing Month program for the past few years.

- Extensive work with a variety of common JavaScript frameworks, including Ember.js, jQuery, YUI, ExtJS, and Three.js
- Past experience with Java- and PHP-based web applications
- Proficient with a variety of visual design tools for prototyping and wireframing, including Photoshop and GIMP
- Practiced Agile/Scrum techniques and methodologies as a team member and a Scrum Master

positions.title: Software Applications Development Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed and maintained a variety of applications, components, and add-on packages using Ember.js, including one application built from the ground up using Ember CLI.
* Extended a major internal advertiser management platform to enable support for the creation, modification, and preview of a new ad format.
* Participated regularly in code reviews for novice and experienced front-end engineers.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
* Designed and developed complex front-end interfaces and user experiences for web-based data management, dashboard, and exam delivery applications.
* Consulted with other developers on client-side programming techniques.

positions.title: Development Intern
positions.description:
* Designed and developed a customizable personal portal for consumers.
* Produced tools, methods, and documentation for embedding company products and technologies on third-party websites.

positions.title: Language Assistant
positions.description: * Provided French-speaking students with real-world language experience through the exploration of video, audio, and print samples of American media as a supplement to their English curriculum.

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description:
* Assisted court clerks with the transition to new methods of data entry and storage.
* Processed new court documents and invoices.
* Provided technical support to court staff.

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
* Assisted staff and faculty with design, deployment, and maintenance of their professional web presence.
* Authored and maintained detailed documentation and tutorials for use with scripting languages and development tools.

positions.title: Design Intern
positions.description: * Designed and implemented wireframes for professional web sites.
